useCases.title: Prepare a workshop using my connected tools
useCases.message: Help me prepare for a team workshop. Ask me what it's about. You might want to check which tools the team uses from what you know about our stack. Then pull relevant context from Slack, Notion, email, and other connected sources to build the agenda and materials.
